acceptance: Test: `get_connection_from_pool` succeeds for every registered adapter against its driver fake, or the failure is an asserted, documented exemption.
ClickHouse server and Velox pool failures are explained in the PR.
description:
## Problem (observed by the contract-test author against fakes)
`get_connection_from_pool` calls `create_connection(**config)` with the whole platform configuration. For Glue and MotherDuck that raises `TypeError` (MotherDuck's signature is `create_connection(connection_config: dict | None)`). The same helper also failed for ClickHouse server (`TypeError`) and Velox (`AttributeError`) in the test harness; those two were not investigated and may come from the fakes.

## Change
- Make the pooled-connection path call `create_connection` the way each adapter's signature requires.
- Investigate the ClickHouse server and Velox failures and either fix them or document why they are harness artifacts.
- Cover the pooled path for every adapter in a signature-conformance test.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Existing pooled behaviour for adapters that work today.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow.
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`; then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`. Re-read every anchor before editing.
